title: Agassiz National Wildlife Refuge
summary: Agassiz National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1937. Its primary purpose was to be a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife. The refuge is located in northwestern Minnesota in the aspen parkland transitional zone between the tallgrass prairie to the west and the coniferous forest to the east.
